title: 第21章 射狼第22章 以神御身
content_zh:
第二天，莱茵·格林和默里·格林骑马赶到狩猎的地方——卡亚斯山。
这座山是埃利斯学院专属猎场，每年学院都会派老师入山调查，调查到的魔兽分布情况与魔法植物生长位置会制作成档案，为新一年的学院任务提供参考。
在学校的管控下，卡亚斯山中最高的魔兽等级为四级，不过都在山脉深处，没有特殊情况，这些四级魔兽都不会离开自己的领地。
卡亚斯山的入山口处，来做学校任务和历练的学生特别多，而且有学长学姐在入口附近摆摊卖物资，收魔法材料，非常热闹。
默里·格林下马，揉了揉勉强休整好的大腿，牵着马，跟着莱茵·格林把马匹存放在马匹存放处，然后走进一栋三层楼高的建筑。
学生任务大厅。
“两人，没有任务，入山打猎。”
莱茵·格林和默里·格林拿出学生卡，在任务大厅登记，一名年龄和他们差不多大的女生接过两人的学生卡后，把它们放在一个覆盖着魔法阵纹的小台子上，然后公式化的问道。
“入山守则知道吗？”
“知道。”
“会在山中过夜吗？”
“不会。”
……
服务女生问了几个问题后，就从柜台下面拿出两个信号弹，与学生卡一起递了过来，默里·格林上前接过。
“谢谢。”
“不用谢，遇到危险就发射信号弹，有守山老师看到后就第一时间赶来迎救。”
走出任务大厅，默里·格林检查了一下自己身上带的装备，身上穿着件皮甲，背着一把百斤拉力的长弓，一壶箭，腰间一边挂着把单手剑，一边插着魔晶枪，身上还挂水壶和一些顶饿又方便的熏肉。
看了下大哥莱茵·格林，只见他只穿了件半身甲，提着把双手剑，身后背着一个应急包。
“莱茵。”
“是莱茵·格林诶！”

入山口处有不少学生，当莱茵·格林两人走过去的时候，周围认出莱茵·格林的人喊出了他的名字，就在这时，一个游侠打扮的学长快步走到莱茵·格林面前。
“哈哈哈，莱茵，你入山干啥？我接了个任务，你要是没任务的话，要不和我们一起去做任务，我分你三成任务奖励。”
“不了，我今天带我弟弟来打猎，入山不深，就不跟着你们一起了。”
面对这位学长的邀请，莱茵·格林直接指了指默里·格林，摇头拒绝，看到莱茵·格林身旁的默里·格林，那位学长有些失望，不过却没多说什么，说了声下次有空一起，就告别两人，带着他的队伍入山。
周围也准备邀请莱茵·格林一起做任务的人，看到莱茵·格林不准备入山太深，不打魔兽，也就和莱茵·格林打了声招呼后就散了。
“哥，你挺抢手的呀！这么多人都想和你一起去做任务。”
“因为我足够强。”
莱茵·格林自信的说道。
content_en:
The next day, Rhine Green and Murray Green rode to the hunting place - Mount Kayas.
This mountain is the exclusive hunting ground of Ellis College. Every year, the college sends teachers into the mountain to investigate. The distribution of magical beasts and the growth locations of magical plants will be compiled into files to provide reference for the college's tasks in the new year.
Under the control of the school, the highest level of monsters in Kayas Mountain is level four, but they are all deep in the mountains. Without special circumstances, these level four monsters will not leave their territory.
At the entrance of Kayas Mountain, there are a lot of students coming for school tasks and training. There are also seniors setting up stalls near the entrance selling supplies and collecting magic materials, which is very lively.
Murray Green dismounted, rubbed his barely rested thighs, led the horse, followed Rhine Green to store the horses in the horse storage room, and then walked into a three-story building.
Student Task Hall.
"Two people, without any mission, went into the mountains to hunt."
Rhine Green and Murray Green took out their student cards and registered in the mission hall. A girl about the same age as them took their student cards, put them on a small table covered with magic arrays, and then asked in a formulaic manner.
"Do you know the rules for entering the mountain?"
"I know."
"Will you spend the night in the mountains?"
"No."
…
After the service girl asked a few questions, she took out two flares from under the counter and handed them over together with her student card. Murray Green stepped forward to take them.
"Thank you."
"You're welcome. If you're in danger, just fire the flare. Teacher Moriyama will come to rescue you as soon as you see it."
After walking out of the mission hall, Murray Green checked the equipment he was carrying. He was wearing leather armor, carrying a long bow with a hundred kilograms of draw power, a pot of arrows, a one-handed sword hanging on one side of his waist, and a magic crystal gun on the other. He also hung a kettle and some hungry but convenient bacon.
Looking at the eldest brother, Rhine Green, I saw that he was only wearing half armor, carrying a two-handed sword, and carrying an emergency bag behind his back.
"Rhine."
"It's Rhine Green!"
There were many students at the entrance to the mountain. When Rhine Green walked past, people around him who recognized Rhine Green called out his name. At this moment, a senior student dressed as a ranger quickly walked up to Rhine Green.
"Hahaha, Rhine, what are you doing in the mountains? I accepted a mission. If you don't have a mission, why don't you go on the mission with us? I'll give you 30% of the mission reward."
"No, I will take my brother hunting today. If we don't go deep into the mountains, I won't go with you."
Faced with the senior's invitation, Rhine Green pointed directly at Murray Green and shook his head to refuse. Seeing Murray Green next to Rhine Green, the senior was a little disappointed, but he didn't say much. He said goodbye to the two of them when we were free next time, and led his team into the mountain.
The people around who were also planning to invite Rhine Green to do the mission together saw that Rhine Green was not going to go too deep into the mountains or fight against the monsters, so they said hello to Rhine Green and dispersed.
"Brother, you are quite popular! So many people want to do missions with you."
"Because I'm strong enough."
Rhine Green said confidently.
